name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: The full name of the citizen applying for the new water connection.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as recorded on official government identification documents.

name: Father's or Husband's Name
whatItMeans: The name of the applicant's father or spouse.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of your father or husband.

name: Mobile Number
whatItMeans: The active contact telephone number of the applicant for receiving updates and OTPs.

name: Email ID
whatItMeans: The electronic mail address of the applicant.

name: Property Assessment Number / PTIN
whatItMeans: The unique property tax identification number assigned to the building or plot by the municipal corporation.
whatToEnter: Enter the property assessment number or PTIN as printed on your property tax receipt.

name: Door Number
whatItMeans: The official municipal door or house number of the premises.
whatToEnter: Enter your exact door or house number.

name: Locality / Street Name
whatItMeans: The specific street, colony, or locality where the property is located.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of your street, colony, or residential locality.

name: Ward Number
whatItMeans: The municipal ward number under Warangal Municipal Corporation where the property is situated.

name: Pin Code
whatItMeans: The postal index number of the property location.

name: Type of Connection
whatItMeans: The category of water connection being requested, such as domestic or commercial.
whatToEnter: Select the appropriate water connection category (e.g., Domestic, Commercial).

name: Pipe Size Required
whatItMeans: The diameter of the water supply pipe requested for the connection.
whatToEnter: Select or enter the required pipe size in inches (e.g., 1/2 inch, 3/4 inch).
